notes.title: Mini Games!
notes.content:
Now you can play mini-games by selecting from menu. 'Alien Shooter' and 'Moon Runners' are all yours to try out for max score! Happy gaming :)

notes.title: New Mini Game & Bug Fixes
notes.content: New mini game is added. Some bug fixes, ui changes & movement system changes

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Loading screen fixes

notes.title: Health System, Mini Games & Devil Booster
notes.content: Mini-games & health system added. YOu can play mini games to get more health. Devil PowerUp has booster now. After reaching the score of 48, you can unlock devil powerUp, which will have fire booster ability now. Have a nice time playing the game :)

notes.title: Slow-Mo Update
notes.content: When you stop, time slows down, try it when you feel vulnerable <3

notes.title: Ghost Lantern!
notes.content: White clouds & Ghost Lantern is here to disturb you! They will mess with your orientation while you try to reach 200 challenge! Are you up for the CHALLENGE!

notes.title: Angel PowerUp Boosters
notes.content: Booster Treasure Chests are here! Get booster and shoot every red & pink around you with increased speed & increasing booster timer!

notes.content: Options menu buttons mouse click bug fixed. Switch button visual changes

notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content: Fly not dying on fire dash & enemy model activations fixed

notes.title: Visual Changes & Minor Fixes
notes.content: Poison cloud visual changes, flying enemies now drop poisonous clouds when they die. Minor animation fixes.

notes.title: Power-Ups & Treasure Chests Update
notes.content: Player can get 2 power ups now. One is an automated holy ball with Angel skin, the other one is burning dash with Devil skin. Happy Hunting!

notes.title: New Power : Stealth & Background Update
notes.content:
You can go stealth now, eat greens to fill up your stealth bar and go stealth when you have no other options.
Background has been changed to make the environment more slimy, more underwaterish.
